messages:
Sam: FYI I'm going to refresh the Python Quickstart — focusing on the auth snippet and 'first deploy' steps. I'll open a PR with the simplified snippet + a short note about env var names. @Priya @Alex — can you eyeball once I push?

Priya: Thanks — yes please. We changed the SDK env var name last week (REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_KEY). Also would be great to remove the old pip extras note.

Sam: Good call. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 (WIP). I updated the snippet and added a tiny docker run example. CI is running.

Alex: Quick note — the snippet linter flags long lines. I can run black/flit before you publish.

doc-bot: Preview available: https://deploy-preview-842--docs.redwood.com/quickstart

Sam: Pasting the new snippet here so you can see inline:
```
from redwood import Client
import os

client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
resp = client.generate("Say hi to Redwood")
print(resp.text)
```

Priya: That looks much cleaner. Add a 1-line Windows env var example (PowerShell) and we're good.

Alex: I'm picking up the linting fix now. Will push a commit to the same branch.

CI-bot: build/test failed — docs-snippet-lint: line-length (quickstart.md:32)

Alex: Fixed and pushed. Also trimmed an extra sentence in the docker example to keep it concise.

Sam: Great — @Priya if preview looks ok can you approve the PR? I'll merge once CI is green. :thumbsup:

Priya: Review complete — small nit about wording in the 'deploy' section, added a suggested edit. :ok_hand:

CI-bot: All checks passed — ready to merge.

Sam: Merged and backfilled redirect for old env var page. Thanks everyone! :tada:

Priya: Nice, can we add a one-liner in the upgrade notes about the env var rename? I'll open a tiny follow-up PR.

Sam: Yes please. Tag me and mark it docs-triage. Done for now.
